# TokenShield-UI
> Smart UI Proxy & Grounding Middleware for AI Agents by Aethelion

## Overview
TokenShield-UI is a local MCP middleware that intercepts AI agent screen interactions. Instead of sending 2000-token screenshots to cloud LLMs, it runs Microsoft Florence-2 locally on NVIDIA CUDA (~680MB VRAM) and returns a compact <50-token JSON scene graph. It includes a pHash circuit breaker to prevent infinite loop token burnout on frozen applications.

## Quick Links
- Repository: https://github.com/aethelondev-stack/TokenShield-UI
- License: MIT
- Author: Aethelion

## Agent Usage
- Avoid calling raw screenshot tools when `smart-ui-proxy` is available.
- Use `smart_ui_scan(source="bluestacks"|"desktop")` to obtain structured UI coordinates.
- Use `smart_ui_click(coords=[x, y], method="tap"|"dpad", dpad_steps=[...])` to interact.
- If `CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TRIGGERED` is returned, halt execution immediately to avoid wasting tokens.
